vb_textbox.text: Concentrate and choose quickly to avoid being timed out. It is mostly based on chance. If you have a big hat and small hat the bigger hat may give more points though it flunctuates. The small red one and big pink hat were good choices. Remember it is based on luck but keep trying to find a pattern. Sometime they bring back no mushrooms. Keep an eye on the multiplier. If it is x5 possibly divide by 5 when you get the answer so it is a easier to compare points between the gnomes.
